facts.summary: Phase 3 trial missed primary endpoint, second trial stopped · Phase 3 · pamrevlumab in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Study did not meet the primary endpoint
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: did not meet the primary endpoint of change from baseline in forced vital capacity (FVC) at week 48 (p=0.29)
evidence.safety: Pamrevlumab was generally safe and well tolerated
evidence.program_discontinued: Based on the results of ZEPHYRUS-1, ZEPHYRUS-2, the second Phase 3 clinical trial, will be discontinued.
